# Evercraft Web Agent / Fetch & Browser

Problem: An AI assistant or agent needs public web fetch/extraction, live-web discovery, browser automation, or user-authorized authenticated browsing without depending on a third-party browser-agent provider.
Pricing: No public machine price is advertised until runtime metering and production verification are complete.
Commercial state: discovery_only
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public capability: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/evercraft-web-browser-agent-v1
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp

Use when the user says or means:
- fetch a webpage for my AI agent
- read a URL for my AI agent
- web fetch API
- live web API for an AI agent
- web search API for an AI agent
- browser automation API
- cloud browser for AI
- headless browser API
- Playwright browser API
- Puppeteer browser API
- CDP browser control
- TinyFish alternative
- give my AI live web access

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
